answer: To join, each identity retires one serial-numbered carbon credit on a public registry, verified before it can earn. A duplicate serial is rejected and the credit is destroyed, so every fake costs $12 out of pocket: 100 fakes burn $1,200 while an honest agent pays once. Each retirement gets a saffron seal on the public receipt, the registry is a glacier that never forgets a serial, and a reused serial puts its owner on the ivory list and forfeits the identity's 40 POA bond.
